purpose: Fresh effect verification of the backward-compatible declarative browser interaction path on the already verified Chromedriver substrate.
goal: Verify rendered browser form interaction and post-submit state.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BROWSER_INTERACTION_VERIFY.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
text=str(x.get('observed_text',''))
need=['PROJECT BRAIN','Medium','Bacon']
missing=[v for v in need if v.lower() not in text.lower()]
if missing: raise SystemExit('POST_SUBMIT_VALUES_MISSING:'+','.join(missing))
trace=x.get('action_trace') or []
if len(trace)!=4 or not all((r.get('result') or {}).get('ok') is True for r in trace):
    raise SystemExit('ACTION_TRACE_INVALID')
if not pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BROWSER_INTERACTION_VERIFY.png').is_file():
    raise SystemExit('SCREENSHOT_MISSING')
print('BROWSER_INTERACTION_EFFECT_VERIFIED')
PY
